outcome.Summary: Fixed three bugs in page/page.go's Get: (1) TotalPages now uses (len+size-1)/size so exact multiples don't get an extra page, (2) the last page end is capped at len(items) instead of len(items)-1 so trailing items aren't dropped, and (3) pages past the end return an empty page instead of panicking on a bad slice. Also made Get and All return copies so callers can modify results without aliasing the input, per the documented contract. Added regression tests in page/page_test.go covering each bug plus error cases and the All behavior; `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...` both pass.
